about_the_game:
Zompell is a single-player first-person zombie survival game that drops you into the heart of a fortified military base under siege. In this action-packed demo, you'll face wave after wave of the undead using a combination of modern weapons and experimental superpowers developed for extreme combat scenarios.

Armed with your rifle and a limited but growing set of abilities, your mission is simple: hold the line and survive.

Demo Features:

One high-intensity map: Defend a military base overrun by zombies in a contained yet challenging environment.

Superpowers system: Unlock and upgrade unique powers across four categories—each offering different tactical advantages.

Progression through survival: Earn spell points by eliminating enemies and use them to enhance your powers mid-game.

Combat support: Deploy high-tech tools like drones to assist in your defense and tactical strategy.

Customizable gameplay: Adjust core settings like infinite health, infinite ammo, minimap visibility, and more to tailor your experience, from casual play to hardcore challenge.

Smart enemy AI: Zombies attack in waves with increasing intensity and behaviors designed to test your skills.

This is just the beginning. The full version of Zompell will feature multiple maps, new enemy types, expanded super powers, deeper survival mechanics, and a full mission-based campaign to uncover the origins of the outbreak and fight back across a variety of environments.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains fantasy violence involving combat against zombie enemies. Players will engage in shooting and melee attacks using firearms and other weapons. Enemies may bleed or fall apart when defeated, but there is no graphic gore or dismemberment. The game includes depictions of skeletal creatures and occasional use of mild derogatory language. There is no sexual content, drug use, or real-world violence directed at vulnerable groups.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: 4 hardware CPU threads - Intel® Core™ i5 750 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card must be 1 GB or more and should be a DirectX 11
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 13 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard output
  • Additional Notes: SSD is highly recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: i7-12700k
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 4070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 13 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard output
  • Additional Notes: SSD is highly recommended

short_description: Zompell Demo is a fast-paced single-player zombie survival FPS set in a fortified military base. Use high-tech gear and experimental superpowers to survive relentless waves of the undead. In this demo, battle through one intense map and upgrade your powers to hold the line.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese
